exposure: Cases: Women who underwent relaparotomy for bleeding after cesarean delivery (RLACD)
longer duration of interval between CD and relaparotomy
Controls: Women with noncomplicated cesarean deliveries
Interval between cesarean delivery and relaparotomy
outcome: Maternal near-miss event due to bleeding
cohort: Women who underwent cesarean delivery between 2012 and 2017
finding: Longer duration of cesarean delivery, increased number of prior cesarean deliveries, and preeclampsia were independent risk factors for RLACD.
